intended_object: For a multivariate QPF F, given by a polynomial functor P with abstraction map abs : P α → F α, the property that abs preserves the predicate lifting LiftP. That is, for every family of predicates p and every x : P α, LiftP p (abs x) holds exactly when LiftP p x holds. This comes from the docstring and from Avigad–Carneiro–Hudon, "Data Types as Quotients of Polynomial Functors".
explanation:
The body states exactly this property: for every α, every family of predicates p, and every x : q.P α, `LiftP p (abs x) ↔ LiftP p x`. That matches the condition in the reference paper.

The setting is already the natural one. It is stated for an arbitrary n-ary QPF, and the only structure it uses is `abs` and `LiftP`.

The library uses the definition as the paper does. It proves `suppPreservation_iff_liftpPreservation` and `liftpPreservation_iff_uniform`, which are the paper's equivalences between the preservation properties and uniformity.

`QPF.LiftpPreservation` in `Mathlib/Data/QPF/Univariate/Basic.lean` is the one-variable version of the same property. It is a special case, not a more general definition, so I have not listed it as the counterpart.
